query: with prev as (select public.previous_utc_iso_week_id(now()) as w) select s.rank, s.username, s.badge_tier, coalesce((p.inventory->>('badge_'||lower(s.badge_tier)))::int,0) as inv_badge, exists(select 1 from badge_grants g where g.player_id=s.telegram_id::text and g.week_id=s.week_id) as has_grant from weekly_leaderboard_snapshots s join prev on s.week_id = prev.w left join players p on p.telegram_id::text = s.telegram_id::text where s.badge_tier is not null order by s.rank limit 20
